_comment: Wake rule (SPEC 3.1): a family wakes if EITHER a changed file path matches one of its globs OR the diff CONTENT contains one of its content_signals. Content-signal matching is MANDATORY: path globs alone miss security/data bugs in generically-named files (e.g. src/lib/userSync.ts) — lesson 1. Multiple families may wake on one file; the Orchestrator dedups post-hoc (Step 6). Over-waking is safe; under-waking is not. The generalist family ALWAYS also wakes when a changed/deleted file matches no family, when the diff deletes code, or when routing is uncertain. The deterministic static pre-pass (orchestrator/static-checks.md) runs BEFORE families fan out and does NOT consume an agent call.
_globs_note: Use filename-anywhere globs (**/*ingest*) NOT folder-only (**/ingest*/**) — VALIDATED 2026-06-11 against /tmp/joblet-src: root-level ingest-*.js scripts exist (ingest-joveo-partner.js, ingest-joveo-v2.js, ingest-xml-feeds.js, direct-ingest.js, retry-organic-feed.js, etc.) and folder-only globs were missing them. All globs below were validated against the real tree: src/lib/supabase.ts (E14), src/lib/csp.ts (E4), src/lib/*Service.ts (E6, 5+ files), api-handlers/_lib/postgrestQuote.js, scripts/self-healing/workers/{serviceProbe,applyLinkChecker}.js (D14/D17), lib/rate-limit.ts, middleware.ts, vercel.json, app/api/cron, app/api/selfheal all resolve. Canonical table = jobs_joveo_partner_v2; api/*.js renamed to api-handlers/*.js.

security._scope: secrets, auth, authorization, injection, data exposure (hardcoded keys, admin client + user input, unsanitized .or()/.filter(), IDOR, CSRF, XSS, fail-open auth, token-in-localStorage, unverified-email account linking)

database._scope: correctness/idempotency/safety of DB reads & writes (wrong/legacy table vs jobs_joveo_partner_v2, non-idempotent inserts, mass destructive writes without staleness/kill-switch, .limit() with no ORDER BY = P1, fire-and-forget un-awaited writes, count:'exact' on hot path, unchecked {data,error}, SELECT-then-INSERT races)

search._scope: search/autocomplete/suggestion correctness and relevance (ilike '%term%' ignoring FTS/trigram index, client-side ranking, ranking-destroying post-processing like diversifyByCompany after DB rank, unsanitized .or() in suggestions, duplicate endpoints, unjustified ranking-formula changes)

frontend-seo-aeo._scope: SEO/AEO correctness + frontend logic hygiene (D1/D2 split). SEO is DETERMINISTIC and handled by the static pre-pass (orchestrator/static-checks.md: S-CANON, S-ROBOTS, S-SITEMAP-SLASH, S-NOINDEX), NOT the agent loop. The agent loop owns frontend logic (CSP regressions, select('*') over-fetch, useEffect without AbortController/cleanup) and AEO readiness.

middleware-scalability._scope: middleware, caching, connection pooling, frontend<->backend scalability (per-isolate Map rate-limiter/cache semantics, pool contention between cron/ingest/live traffic, missing backpressure, Cache-Control on SSR, missing request timeout/size limit). Thresholds MEASURED from the load test (see _measured_facts) — no longer a stub. The rate limiter is CORRECT BY DESIGN: do NOT flag per-isolate rate limiting as a defect; the defect class is MISSING or OVER-WIDE limits.

cron-reliability._scope: cron handlers, self-healing workers, scheduler correctness, operational safety (health probe treating 4xx as healthy, missing circuit breaker/backpressure, run-logger losing records, no alert on cron failure, scheduler races/duplicate schedules, destructive worker without kill-switch, missing TTL/cutoff, .limit() without ORDER BY = P1, fail-open cron auth = P0)

generalist._scope: fallback recall safety-net; no static checklist, pure open-ended hunt. Wakes on unclaimed files, deletions, or routing uncertainty so no PR passes with zero families awake.
generalist._comment: ALWAYS also wakes when: a changed/deleted file matches NO other family, OR the diff deletes code, OR routing is uncertain ('when unsure, wake everything'). Recall-first; NO static checklist — pure open-ended hunt. Guarantee: no PR ever passes with zero families awake.

fast._note: Researcher fires ONLY on Cynic needs-research or diff novelty

limits.on_timeout: drop finding to needs-human, continue, note visibly in report — never block the whole report on one hung agent, never drop silently
